title: Is your savings account paying you almost nothing?

lines.text: Is your savings account paying you almost nothing? Dot, how do we fix that?
Look at a high-yield savings account. It's a savings account that pays a much higher interest rate.

scene.def: A savings account that pays a [higher rate].

lines.text: Here's five thousand dollars for a year, at example rates of 0.4% versus 3.5%.
lines.say: Here's five thousand dollars for a year, at example rates of zero point four percent, versus three point five percent.

lines.text: Same money, same safety. Look for FDIC insurance, which covers up to $250,000 per depositor, per bank, per account type.

scene.label: FDIC insurance limit
scene.note: Per depositor, per bank, per [account type]

lines.say: Same money, same safety. Look for F D I C insurance, which covers up to two hundred and fifty thousand dollars per depositor, per bank, per account type.

lines.text: Keep checking for daily spending, and park your savings where it earns more. Rates change, so compare before you open one.
That's the money. See you at the next bell.
